title: Craftable End Portal Frame
description: A very simple data pack that I made while experimenting as a beginner that allows the end portal frame blocks to be crafted using 7 end stone, 1 ender pearl and 1 eye of ender. It does not make the end portal frame destructible. This is my first data pack.
body: This data pack allows the end portal frame blocks to be crafted using 7 end stone, 1 ender pearl and 1 eye of ender. This allows the player to craft the portal wherever they please. The data pack does **_not_** make the end portal frames destructible, so be careful where you place them!
